prompt:
Create ONE large, beautifully organized high-resolution ACCESSORY SHOP CONCEPT ARTBOARD for the original Bloomlings cozy mobile garden game. The owner wants to see the proposed ENTIRE SMALL COSMETIC COLLECTION on a single image: EXACTLY FOUR HERO COLUMNS, with TEN DISTINCT SEPARATE ACCESSORIES PER HERO (40 accessory objects total), arranged in matching seasonal sets. The attached images establish the cute premium sculpted 3D material style, character silhouettes and colors. This is a product concept sheet of modeled attachable accessories, NOT an app screenshot, NOT a scene and NOT 40 dressed characters.

COMPOSITION / LEGIBILITY: Landscape 4:3 or near-square generously sized artboard. Warm ivory background. A restrained elegant small title at top "BLOOMLINGS • GARDEN WARDROBE". Four clear equal-width columns labeled SPRIG, BLOOM, DROP, TWIG. Each column header has a SMALL neat portrait of the corresponding reference hero for identification, leaving most space for actual accessory objects. Use the recent cute big-head short-body heroes with small narrow bodies, NOT fat, with Drop a droplet HEAD over a separate tiny body. Soft unobtrusive column separators. Below headers, FOUR horizontal SEASONAL BANDS spanning all columns, with slim calm tinted backgrounds and a single left-edge season label: SUMMER, AUTUMN, WINTER, NEW YEAR. Summer and autumn bands slightly taller because each contains THREE objects per hero. Winter and New Year contain TWO per hero. Each accessory fully separated with generous negative space and no overlapping other objects. In each seasonal cell arrange the 2 or 3 separate products as an attractive small product grouping. No price tags, purchase buttons, coins, rarity frames or decorative filler. Do not clutter the board with annotations. Only small clear hero names and season names, no tiny item text. Make individual items LARGE ENOUGH to inspect with clear silhouettes.

ART DIRECTION: Premium charming stylized 3D items suitable for these adorable tiny garden spirits. Soft rounded edges, thick readable forms, clean satin surfaces, subtle fabric folds and broad stitching only, warm bright studio light and light grounding shadows, pleasing restrained coordinated seasonal colors. Simple buildable rigid wearable objects rather than full costumes. Nature motifs, tiny cream flower accents, leaves, acorns, simple water motifs. No realistic rust, grime, photoreal fabric noise, filigree, glitter, floating confetti or excessive tiny dangling parts. Hero colors are accents, not one monotonous flat color per column. Accessories should feel from the same shop but be recognizably customized to each hero in shape and motif, not simple recolors of identical meshes.

ATTACHMENT / SHAPES: Caps and berets are small charming tilted perched hats that preserve the natural leaf quiff of Sprig, flower petal halo of Bloom, single tip of Drop, acorn cap and stem of Twig. Give hats a discreet open-back/notch or short open band where appropriate rather than a giant closed helmet. Glasses have broad rounded frames and clear lightly tinted lenses, fit wide cartoon eyes, do not include a face. Backpacks have straps, visible chunky simple shoulder straps and backs, shown at a readable three-quarter angle. Show each object on its own, no mannequin head, no hands or body embedded in products. A pair of glasses is ONE accessory, earmuffs are ONE accessory, scarf ONE, capelet ONE.

EXACT INVENTORY BY SEASON AND HERO:

SUMMER — THREE objects in EACH hero column (cap + sunglasses + backpack):
SPRIG: fresh leafy green baseball cap with a SMALL white daisy on the side and softly curved bill; rounded moss-green sunglasses with a cream bridge; tiny mint-and-leaf-green backpack with a daisy pocket and leaf-shaped flap.
BLOOM: cream-and-soft-rose small tilted sun cap with a pink petal accent; rounded blush sunglasses with softly scalloped outer corners; cream mini backpack with a rose petal-shaped flap and one yellow flower button.
DROP: aqua-and-cream small cap with a subtle notch for the head tip and a little white daisy emblem; translucent sea-blue rounded sunglasses; small aqua backpack with a simple shell-shaped pocket and cream straps.
TWIG: sage green explorer cap with a tiny daisy and warm brown bill, designed to perch on the acorn cap; amber rounded sunglasses with subtle wood-colored temples; honey-and-sage explorer backpack with an acorn-shaped clasp.

AUTUMN — THREE objects in EACH hero column (beret + scarf + crossbody satchel):
SPRIG: warm moss-green tilted beret with ONE orange maple-leaf patch; short burnt-orange scarf tied in a simple soft knot; small chestnut satchel with a broad maple-leaf flap and a single crossbody strap.
BLOOM: muted plum tilted beret with a peach flower button; warm cream scarf with broad rose and rust bands; small rose-and-caramel flower-shaped satchel with a simple strap.
DROP: muted teal beret with a small golden leaf accent and notch for the droplet tip; short mustard-yellow scarf; teal crossbody satchel with a rounded raindrop flap and warm tan strap.
TWIG: cinnamon-colored tiny beret with a sage leaf accent, perches on existing cap; muted ochre scarf with broad simple ribbing; warm brown acorn-shaped satchel with cream strap.

WINTER — TWO objects in EACH hero column (earmuffs + short capelet):
SPRIG: soft ivory earmuffs joined by a sage-green OPEN band with one leaf accent; short sage-and-cream cozy shoulder capelet with a chunky simple leaf clasp.
BLOOM: powder-pink earmuffs with a cream band and small petal accent; short dusty-rose capelet with a soft ivory edge and little flower clasp.
DROP: pale blue earmuffs with a navy OPEN band that clears the head tip; short ice-blue capelet with ivory edging and one simple snowflake clasp.
TWIG: caramel-and-cream earmuffs with a warm brown open band; short cocoa capelet with ivory trim and a simple acorn clasp.
Capelets are compact shoulder accessories, not long coats, not dresses and not full body suits. Earmuffs look like complete wearable pairs on a band.

NEW YEAR — TWO objects in EACH hero column (festive head accessory + gift backpack):
SPRIG: tiny tilted dark-green Santa-style cap with a cream pompom, red berry and two small leaves; little forest-green gift-box backpack with broad cream ribbon.
BLOOM: small cream OPEN headband with a simple rose-gold five-point star and one pink blossom; little rose-pink gift-box backpack with broad champagne ribbon.
DROP: tiny ice-blue Santa-style cap with ivory trim, little pompom and opening for head tip; little sapphire-blue gift-box backpack with broad white ribbon and one small snowflake.
TWIG: tiny tilted warm-red Santa-style cap with ivory trim and acorn-shaped pompom; little cranberry-red gift-box backpack with broad gold ribbon and small green leaf tag.

IMPORTANT COUNT: Each column has exactly 3 summer + 3 autumn + 2 winter + 2 New Year items = TEN. Across four hero columns = FORTY. All items are separate objects, no merged objects that conceal others. Do not add decorative stand-alone seasonal objects or extra merchandise. Unify visual scale so caps, glasses and backpacks all read clearly. A refined game art production moodboard that is charming and practical, not a noisy retail poster.
